catalog.title: My Twin Sister Took My Place as His Wife

evidence_notes.source: Full read of the 30-chapter manuscript (scratchpad catalog/twin_sister.md, ~73k words), 2026-10-06. Built from the text only, not blurbs or memory. Mechanical voice and exit data come from series_diff.py run on this file alone.
evidence_notes.lane: Shelf lane marriage_crisis. Exact sub-lane: marriage_repair_by_twin_impersonation. 'lane' is kept as the shared string so same-lane counting works.
evidence_notes.relationship_start: Married 6 yrs (anniversary Ch1/3 = Nov 14). Separated physically for 14 weeks by an injury abroad. The estrangement is unspoken: she stopped asking him for things in March (Ch28) and he stopped waiting for her in October (Ch12).
evidence_notes.opening_engine: Ch1: the heroine comes home early without telling anyone. From across the street, unseen, she watches her twin wear her coat and fake her brace at a 10-person dinner, and sees the husband drink a toast to 'Maud'. Her decisions come from being an unseen witness (she does not cross the street; she goes to her studio).
evidence_notes.inciting_event: Function class: public_erasure. Mechanism: substitution by the twin (commission), ratified by the husband (omission: 'I took the corkscrew... and poured', Ch2/3), before his boss, colleagues and neighbours. The heroine witnesses it alone, from outside. Inciting KIND recorded in the human row = discovery.
evidence_notes.heroine_goal: Function class: clear_name. A sister-and-mother forgery quit her contract (Ch5) and her career in her name (Ch15). She restores her professional name by finishing the altarpiece and getting it certified by Dec 24 (Ch6 contract).
evidence_notes.external_engine: Restoration commission with an independent certifier and a fixed deadline (Christmas Eve re-dedication). Secondary collisions: the hero's promotion deadline (Ch10, Dec 18) and her wrist hardware failing (Ch23).
evidence_notes.agency_pattern: First irreversible decision Ch3: she walks out on the anniversary morning and leaves the house key beside his gift. Ch6 she signs a no-deposit contract she cannot physically perform. Ch7 she dictates the terms that make him her hands.
evidence_notes.hero_error: Takes the load so others won't spend effort (Ch2 origin: mother's night shifts); decides for others and makes repairs invisible ('A very good repair. Invisible.' Ch3). Complicit by omission for 9 weeks; privately relieved by her absence (Ch12).
evidence_notes.power_configuration: In the studio the heroine holds all authority (expertise plus her rules). The hero holds corporate and economic power outside it. An institution (diocesan commission and independent certifier) gates both.
evidence_notes.containment: Ch7: 'You owe me nine weeks. You can pay it in evenings.' Fixed hours, phone in the bowl, no fixing, no deciding, no apologies, she can end it and he can't. Cause: her hand can't do the work and the forgery has turned other conservators away (Ch7).
evidence_notes.midpoint_reversal: Ch15 (of 30): the mentor reads the forged resignation aloud. The heroine re-frames the theft: 'what she had taken was the name', not the house. She stakes the outcome on the log written in his capitals, and the mentor sets 'one entry' terms (the trap the hero later springs). Paired with the mutual confessions in Ch11-12.
evidence_notes.darkest_moment_cause: Ch18-19: while she sleeps, the hero decides to 'take that off your plate'. He ignores a yellow swab, switches to his untrained hand, loses count, and removes irreplaceable 1886 glaze (13 mm). This is his core flaw recurring, with permanent cost. Second trough Ch23: her screw backs out, and she ends the terms because she can't tell 'him' from 'his hands'.
evidence_notes.climax: Ch26-27: she ASKS (not orders) him to come. In her studio on Dec 23 at night, with the certifier watching, he cleans the Virgin's face in six 90-second sections on her spoken count. He reports 'My hand's tired' between sections and stops a millimetre short of the old damage at 'Leave it.' The certifier signs one line on paper. Owner is joint: she designs, decides and counts; he executes with restraint.
evidence_notes.climax_staging: venue = heroine's own studio (workplace) at night. Audience = one certifying examiner (the institution's proxy), with the committee kept on the stairs. Evidence = the act performed, after a silent read of the log including the hinged confession page and a UV check of the damaged corner. Authority = the certifier's written signature. Spectacle = private lines ('Whose hands?' 'His.' / 'Kid.').
evidence_notes.repair: Shape: taught_by_her_on_her_terms (apprenticeship). Sub-acts: corrects the record in person (Ch4, Ch10); obeys the terms (Ch7-17); self-reports the damage in writing (Ch18); declines the promotion (Ch20, unilaterally, which she names as 'the corner again, done kindly', Ch25); 'Ask Maud' before the Monsignor (Ch22); refuses the mother's offer to blame the sister, 'I knew' (Ch24); practises alone without pursuing her (Ch24); apology and 'we decide it' (Ch28). Staging rhythm: fail-then-succeed.
evidence_notes.resolution_visibility: Recommitment is private (studio, Ch28). The public record is corrected by the sister's 11-name list (heroine-dictated, Ch9/21). The hero explicitly refuses public credit ('Not in the photographs', Ch28-29).
evidence_notes.ending_state: Reconciled marriage, renegotiated: her list of asks plus his one ask (Ch28). Forgiveness 'some of the time. Not all of it.' The sister is on probation until March. The mother is not reconciled.
evidence_notes.epilogue_design: Ch30, a March Saturday about 3 months later. Shared studio work: two phones in the bowl, 'What do you need?' asked twice, the sister sits on the stool watching 'the slow part', and he gets a fresh tape square: 'Again.'
evidence_notes.relocation_reset: Heroine moves to her own unheated workplace (Ch3), not a family asset. She returns home only after the climax (Ch28).
evidence_notes.intimacy_function: Closed door. Touch happens through the work and swaps who steadies whom: Ch9 her hand over his (she loses count at 41); Ch17 her tremor grounded on his forearm; Ch19 her hand on his shaking wrist. Single kiss in Ch28 confirms the repair.
evidence_notes.supporting_cast_function: Each deceived person registers the lie and must be told in the sister's own voice (11-name list, Ch9/21). Family pressure from the mother, who co-authored the forgery (Ch14, 21, 24). Mentor and parish act as the gate. Charm-witnesses (Mrs Hajek, the landlord, the neon-shop neighbour) vouch for the hero's stillness.
evidence_notes.pov_structure: Maud in first-person past, 18 chapters (1,3,5,6,7,9,11,13,14,15,17,19,21,23,25,27,29,30). Declan in close-third past, 12 chapters (2,4,8,10,12,16,18,20,22,24,26,28). Linear Nov 13 to Dec 24, plus a March coda; embedded flashback of the fall in Ch11.
evidence_notes.devices: Technique bank (page-craft 4.1). PRIMARY (reader meets first) = care-object-and-service: Ch2 the hand-washed glasses and the July parcel of magnifiers, carried unopened to Ch28; Ch7 phone into the bowl unasked; Ch11 milky tea in his mother's thermos. First attraction beat = involuntary-symptom (Ch9: her pulse against the brace, the count stops at forty-one). Secondary: narrator-wrong-once / second-look ('if you stayed on it'), mirror line ('take that off your plate'; 'what's the ask'; the 'house where nobody asked'), charm-witness, comic undercut at exit (Ch3, 17, 20), answer-length ladder, contraband object (practice cow painting, Ch24/30), first-inspection (Ch1 face read), cold-hero puncture.
evidence_notes.voice_measured: series_diff.py s6, narration only, per 1k words. Em dash 0.02 (Maud 0.00, Declan 0.06); negative parallelism 0.02; not-exactly 0.02; understood 0; hedge 0; first-time 0; theme 0; filter words 3.64. Top 4-grams: 'end of the bench' x8, 'okay he said and' x7, 'phone in the bowl' x7, 'and put it back' x6. Phrase habits: 'Okay. So.' x12, 'never once' x11, 'Hm' x20 (mentor), 'he did not' x63.
evidence_notes.flags_for_gate: Possible house-template overlaps with earlier pen-name rows (unverified; those rows are not filed yet): numeric_precision voice; involuntary-symptom as the first-attraction device; darkest_moment_cause repeated_core_harm. The inciting function class public_erasure may match an earlier 'public deprioritization' book; the mechanism here is substitution by a relative, witnessed unseen.
